entities.name: PMID:35394585
observations: Study titled “ADC textural features in patients with single brain metastases improve clinical risk models” reports diffusion/ADC changes across the tumor-brain border and peritumoral tissue associated with survival; retrieved summary omitted cohort size and effect estimates.

entities.name: Boundary ADC and survival
observations: For single brain metastases, ADC textural features across the tumor border and in peritumoral brain tissue were reported as associated with survival; the available evidence summary does not establish independent prediction or supply effect sizes.
No boundary-specific evidence retrieved for local recurrence or local control after stereotactic radiosurgery.
